Self.Wiki: This map object represents an environmental map effect box in the map.

EnableDist.Wiki: Distance from camera required before enabling envmap. 0 = always enabled.

TransitionDist.Wiki: Distance it takes for an envmap to fully transition into view.

EnvMapEffectBox_UnkT09.Wiki: Not seen read by the game. Values 0-51 (mostly 20); Elden Ring uses this byte as the priority of older maps.

EnvMapEffectBox_UnkT0A.Wiki: Read by the game together with Unknown: 0xB as one value. 255, or 2 on 7 boxes.

EnvMapEffectBox_UnkT0B.Wiki: Read by the game together with Unknown: 0xA as one value. 255, or 1 on 7 boxes.

SpecularLightMult.Wiki: Strength of specular light in region.

PointLightMult.Wiki: Strength of direct light in region.

EnvMapEffectBox_UnkT2C.Wiki: An unknown flag read by the game. 0, or 255 on 4 retail boxes.

EnvMapEffectBox_UnkT2D.Wiki: An unknown flag read by the game. 0 on every retail box.

IsModifyLight.Wiki: Affects lighting with other fields when true. Possibly normalizes light when false.

EnvMapEffectBox_UnkT2F.Wiki: Not seen read by the game. 0, or 1 on 8 boxes.

EnvMapEffectBox_UnkT30.Wiki: Not seen read by the game. -1, or an ID (4, 100, 305, 400-407, 900) on 26 boxes.

EnvMapEffectBox_UnkT32.Wiki: Read by the game. Values such as 100-225 (often equal to the matching env map point's Unknown: 0x20).
